explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: FDA first posted the dobutamine hydrochloride shortage on 2017-11-06 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
Our Baxter-labeled product (NDC 00338107702) is manufactured at Baxter Healthcare Corporation FEI 1416980, which FDA inspected on 2026-04-02 and classified OAI.
Our Hospira-labeled product (NDC 00409234401) is made at Hospira FEI 1925262, last inspected 2025-01-17 and classified VAI.
Corvale East has 2.4 days on hand and Corvale General has 21 days on hand and can spare 122 units while keeping two weeks.
The rule-ranked option is to transfer 122 units from Corvale General to Corvale East, which would give Corvale East 14 days on hand.

Q-13960d.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%dobutamine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%dobutamine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-649e57.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('6b17b98b-e06d-42ed-925f-69aa2699dead', 'dc537761-d5f4-488d-24ab-b2bcd2b17b7a') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-9ed514.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%dobutamine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-f649c0.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%dobutamine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-ea1fc4.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%dobutamine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-f12ec8.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1416980', '2618677', '1021343', '1925262', '3005115952') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-134ed5.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('baxter', 'hospira') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%dobutamine%' ORDER BY initiation_date
